records.title: Dr. Helen Wambach — 1700 CE Hypnotic Regression Statistical Cohort
records.summary: Part of Wambach's 10-year quantitative study of 1,088 subjects regressed to 10 fixed dates including 1700 CE. Subjects overwhelmingly described mundane lower-class agrarian, artisan, and emerging merchant lives with micro-historically accurate clothing, footwear, and utensils—providing virtually zero corroboration for a global high-tech civilization in 1700.
anomalyMarkers: 50.6% male / 49.4% female ratio matched real historical demographics
Micro-historical accuracy on cooking pots, fabrics, and utensil tines
Zero unprompted reports of advanced domes or atmospheric energy in 1700 CE

sources.title: Reliving Past Lives: The Evidence Under Hypnosis (Helen Wambach, 1979)

records.title: Dr. Helen Wambach — 1850 CE Cohort (Anti-Trope Baseline)
records.summary: Wambach specifically chose 1850 CE to test whether subjects would fabricate romanticized 'Wild West' or Civil War fantasies. Instead, only a small fraction placed themselves in the American West; the vast majority described unglamorous rural farm or town lives, with no reports of a recent global architectural reset or mud flood.
anomalyMarkers: Defied 1970s Hollywood 'Wild West' cultural conditioning
Strong mundane baseline directly inside the 1776–1850 target window
Critical control dataset for testing post-2018 Tartaria regression claims

records.title: Bridey Murphy / Virginia Tighe Regression (1798–1864 Ireland)
records.summary: One of the earliest tape-recorded hypnotic regressions directly inside the 1798–1864 window. Virginia Tighe recounted an ordinary 19th-century Irish life including obscure grocer names (Farr & Carrigan), local coinage, and folklore—entirely consistent with mundane pre-industrial life rather than an advanced global civilization.
anomalyMarkers: Recorded 1952—decades before modern alternative-history internet lore
Spanned exact 1798–1864 window with ordinary domestic and parish detail
Debated between cryptomnesia and genuine historical recall

records.title: Dolores Cannon QHHT — White Stone Domed Cities & Sound/Atmospheric Energy
records.summary: Across The Convoluted Universe series (published 2001–2014, long before Tartaria went viral), multiple independent QHHT subjects described gleaming white stone/marble cities with domes, resonant sound/atmospheric power transmission, and sudden cataclysmic destruction. Notably, hypnotists almost always filed these under 'Atlantis' because no 18th-century category existed.
anomalyMarkers: Pre-2018 unprompted descriptions of white domed architecture & wireless energy
Classic 'Misclassification Hypothesis' candidate (filed under Atlantis)
Recurring motif of sudden water/earth cataclysm wiping technological memory

records.title: Edgar Cayce Trance Readings — Crystal & Atmospheric Power Infrastructure
records.summary: Between 1923 and 1944, Edgar Cayce gave over 700 trance readings referencing an earlier global civilization utilizing resonant crystal/etheric power stations ('Tuaoi Stone'), airships/craft, and wireless energy transmission, ending in three major geophysical cataclysms.
anomalyMarkers: Recorded 1923–1944—completely uncontaminated by modern internet lore
Describes centralized domed energy-distribution temples and airship transit
Places civilization in deep antiquity rather than 1700–1850 CE

records.title: Dr. Michael Newton — Life-Between-Lives 'Hall of Records' & Amnesia Veil

records.summary: Synthesizing thousands of superconscious 'Life Between Lives' sessions, Newton documented recurring reports of a 'Library of Life Books' and a deliberate 'amnesia veil' applied prior to incarnation—offering one metaphysical explanation for why collective civilizational memories fail to carry cleanly across resets.
anomalyMarkers: Documents systematic 'amnesia veil' / memory-filtering before incarnation
Recurring reports of interactive Akashic / Life-Book archives
Past-life Earth memories in Newton's cases remain overwhelmingly mundane

records.title: UVA / Shanti Devi Verified Spontaneous Past-Life Case (Short Intermission)
records.summary: One of the most rigorously investigated spontaneous children's cases (verified by a committee appointed by Mahatma Gandhi and later analyzed by Dr. Ian Stevenson at UVA). Illustrates why UVA's 2,500+ verified cases almost never reach the 1700–1850 window: the median interval between death and rebirth in Stevenson's dataset is only ~15 months.
anomalyMarkers: Explains the 'UVA 1776 Silence': median intermission is ~15 months
Over 24 verifiable historical facts confirmed in Mathura
Spontaneous recall without hypnosis (zero hypnotist suggestion)

records.title: Dr. Jim Tucker (UVA) — James Leininger Verified WWII Aviator Recall
records.summary: Documented by Dr. Jim Tucker at UVA: a toddler with zero aviation exposure gave verifiable names (USS Natoma Bay, Jack Larsen, Corsair fighter) matching WWII pilot James Huston Jr., killed over Chichi Jima in 1945. Demonstrates high-fidelity factual recall—making the absence of 1776–1850 high-tech memories even more notable.
anomalyMarkers: Documented verifiable military/historical facts from a 2-year-old child
Longer intermission (~53 years), proving multi-decade recall is possible
Anchored to Charlottesville UVA DOPS methodology

records.title: NDERF Archive — Panoramic Life Review & Multi-Life 'Bubbles' Pattern
records.summary: Across 5,000+ NDE submissions on NDERF.org, roughly 3–5% report seeing flashes of multiple past lives ('bubbles' or parallel timelines) during their life review. When 1800s eras appear in NDERF, they consistently depict ordinary farms, wilderness, and period attire—never a suppressed 1800s global technological empire.
anomalyMarkers: Only ~3–5% of NDEs include past-life flashes (most review current life only)
1800s NDE visions consistently show mundane rural/period settings
Primary dataset for automated Gemini Flash edge-case scanning

records.title: Howard Storm NDE (1985 Paris) — Uncensored Human History & Future Review
records.summary: During a near-death experience in a Paris hospital in 1985, art professor Howard Storm reported asking luminous beings about human history and the real story of Earth. He was told that official history books are deeply incomplete and distorted, and was shown sweeping civilizational cycles and spiritual turning points.
anomalyMarkers: Explicitly reports that official human history is severely distorted/incomplete
Recorded in 1985 (pre-internet, zero Tartaria contamination)
Also contains specific geopolitical predictions (collapse of USSR)

sources.title: IANDS — International Association for Near-Death Studies

records.title: Mellen-Thomas Benedict NDE (1982) — Earth History & Evolutionary Cycles Download
records.summary: Clinically dead for ~90 minutes in 1982, Benedict reported touring the 'vast archive of human and planetary evolution,' observing recurring peaks and resets of human consciousness and technology across deep time—frequently cited as an archetypal 'Hall of Records' NDE.
anomalyMarkers: One of the most detailed 'cosmic archive / Earth cycles' NDEs on record
Studied by NDE pioneer Dr. Kenneth Ring in the 1980s–1990s
Frames technological peaks as cyclical rather than strictly linear

records.title: Alba Weinman Early Sessions (2016–2018) — Unprompted Flood, Fire & Empty City Motifs
records.summary: Early public YouTube regression sessions recorded prior to the 2019 Tartaria wave, in which subjects spontaneously recounted fleeing sudden wall-of-water / mud cataclysms and leaving behind grand stone cities—prime targets for automated transcript mining via our Gemini Edge-Case Hunter.
anomalyMarkers: Public YouTube archive with hundreds of 1–2 hour transcripts ready for Gemini mining
Pre-2019 sessions allow clean blind comparison against post-2020 prompted sessions
Direct YouTube timestamp linking preserves primary evidence without re-hosting
